name: PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
summary: PT Logisticsplus International Tbk provides transportation management services in Indonesia and internationally. The company also provides warehousing and distribution, fulfillment, logistics, business intelligence, technology, and supply chain solutions. In addition, it offers ocean freight FCL/LCL, RORO, breakbulk and charter vessel/NVOCC, air freight and charter, import and export custom clearance, project cargo and heavy lift, and LC document administration services.
